translations.web: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
translations.bsb: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, attending to the service of the tabernacle.
translations.kjv: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
translations.asv: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tent of meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
